description: The line plot illustrates the loss values of different configurations of a language model over a number of iterations. The x-axis, labeled "#Iteration," is a linear scale ranging from 0 to 140,000 iterations. The y-axis, labeled "Loss," is also a linear scale ranging from 2.4 to 3.4. The plot includes six lines, each representing a different configuration of the language model. The "Vanilla" line is purple, the "StrmLLM (n=64)" line is blue, the "SepLLM (n=64)" line is orange, the "SepLLM (n=64, H)" line is green, the "SepLLM (n=64, H/T)" line is red, and the "SepLLM (n=128)" line is purple. All lines start at a loss value of around 3.3 and decrease over the number of iterations, with the "SepLLM (n=64, H)" and "SepLLM (n=64, H/T)" configurations showing the lowest loss values throughout the iterations.
